invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of a call to .execute(), which should not return null.
context is used as an argument in a constructor and must not be null.
clusteringInstantTime is passed to a constructor and expected to be non-null.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null list if result is non-null.
The size of a list returned by getWriteStatuses() should always be non-negative.
